scope: A reviewed subset of products supported by the ArWen WRF-history import path. Product membership is source-capability metadata, not forecast-skill or GPU qualification. The renderer still checks actual saved fields and complete time windows.

10m_wind_1h_max.input_note: stored sub-hourly 1 h max 10 m wind speed (wind_speed_10m_max_1h) at F003 (top-of-hour instantaneous fallback at F003: no stored sub-hourly max field — a lower bound on the native sub-hourly max)

10m_wind_run_max.input_note: run max of stored sub-hourly 1 h max 10 m wind speeds (top-of-hour instantaneous fallback at F001, F002, F003: no stored sub-hourly max field — a lower bound on the native sub-hourly max)

10m_wind_speed_and_direction.input_note: 10m AGL Wind Speed and Direction [fill: wind_speed_10m_agl]

2m_temp_0_24h_max.input_note: A complete hourly history window through the stated duration is required.

2m_temp_0_24h_min.input_note: A complete hourly history window through the stated duration is required.

qpf_1h.input_note: 1 h APCP differenced from stored run-total accumulations (F003 minus F002); this store carries no native apcp_1h plane

qpf_6h.input_note: A complete hourly history window through the stated duration is required.

uh_2to5km_run_max.input_note: run max of stored sub-hourly 1 h max 2-5 km UH planes (WRF UP_HELI_MAX per-history-interval max at F001, F002, F003: reset each history frame — the exact trailing 1 h max at this hourly cadence)

unavailable.10m_wind_gusts: The wind maximum uses stored 10 m wind snapshots. It is not a gust diagnostic; gust magnitude or a gust swath requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.categorical_freezing_rain: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current ArWen history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.categorical_ice_pellets: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current ArWen history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.categorical_snow: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current ArWen history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.cloud_cover: The requested cloud panel shows low, middle and high layer cloud cover. It does not calculate total cloud fraction.
unavailable.dcape: The current ArWen history renderer does not produce DCAPE. Moisture and temperature context cannot establish downdraft energy; that parcel calculation requires separate analysis.
unavailable.dewpoint_depression_2m: Air temperature and dewpoint are shown separately. Dewpoint depression is not calculated by this history-rendering path and requires separate analysis.
unavailable.heat_index_2m: Air temperature and relative humidity are shown separately. Heat index is not calculated by this history-rendering path and requires separate analysis.
unavailable.lapse_rate_0_3km: The stored 0-3 km lapse-rate plot uses plain temperature. It is not the virtual-temperature lapse rate; the virtual-temperature quantity requires separate analysis.
unavailable.lapse_rate_700_500: The stored 700-500 hPa lapse-rate plot uses plain temperature. It is not the virtual-temperature lapse rate; the virtual-temperature quantity requires separate analysis.
unavailable.precipitation_type: Precipitation-type categories are not supplied by the current ArWen history renderer. Temperature and moisture plots provide environmental context; rain/snow/freezing-rain/ice-pellet classification requires separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.theta_e_2m_10m_winds: The plots show temperature, dewpoint and winds separately. The current ArWen history renderer does not calculate 2 m equivalent potential temperature; that quantity requires separate analysis.
unavailable.visibility: Low cloud cover and near-surface humidity describe the fog environment, not visibility distance. Visibility and verified fog boundaries require separate analysis or observations.
unavailable.vpd_2m: Air temperature and relative humidity are context only. Vapour-pressure deficit is not calculated by this history-rendering path and requires separate analysis.
unavailable.wetbulb_2m: The current ArWen history renderer does not produce 2 m wet-bulb temperature. Air temperature and humidity are context only; wet-bulb temperature requires a separate calculation.
unavailable.wind_chill_2m: Air temperature and 10 m wind are shown separately. Wind chill is not calculated by this history-rendering path and requires separate analysis.
